biggestGap: Grown temperate trees are 17-18 m base, 12-33 m with scatter jitter, against the preset broadleaf 7 m. That is botanically honest - metrics.heightFt is about 57 ft - but this world is art-directed around 7 m trees, so the change roughly doubles apparent tree height everywhere. It was deliberately NOT scaled down by a magic factor. This is an open call for Remy, judged from the images, not a defect to fix quietly.
notes:
Grown trees are LIVE IN THE GAME. The scatter now carries the biome (biomeCodes + biomeTable, cache v4); the ground path resolves treeBiome from the anchor atlas cell FMG biome name.

WHY THE OLD PATH WAS WRONG, and it was worse than known: species came from palette colour, but buildGroundVegetation picks from a THREE-ENTRY green table hashed off the feature id - the same three greens everywhere on the map. classifySpecies gave a fixed 3-way split regardless of biome, and its third entry landed in the rainforest band. PALMS GREW ON TUNDRA, and that was shipping.

PERF IMPROVED on every axis at cell 785, same 1,620 trees: 8 draws vs 40, 8.18M triangles vs 12.42M, asset build 91 ms vs 513 ms.

Four biomes proven in-game from one seed: temperate deciduous forest, tropical rainforest, wetland, hot desert. ez-tree still reachable at ?trees=preset.

A FALSE ALARM WORTH RECORDING: an earlier in-game capture looked like a tangle of leaning beige poles and was flagged as broken. It was a FRAMING artifact - the camera sat 90 m out at 22 m height, inside the crown layer of a 17 m stand. Four wiring hypotheses were tested empirically and all were negative: geometry bbox is exactly unitH 1.000 base y=0, the grown path never touches SPECIES_HEIGHT_M, the instancer applies no tilt at all, and the bark/foliage split uses the same threshold and material.
